Okeechobee Farms & Whole Life Foods

Wild Sourced & 100% Grass Fed Meats Direct to Consumer

Okeechobee Farms is over 40,000 acers of pristine pastures located in Central South Florida. Our beef cattle and lambs are 100% grass fed. Florida pastured lamb is known to be of the sweetest and cleanest lamb available. All poultry and pork species are pastured free-ranging.

Shop Our Products!

We are advocates of cooking with traditional farm fats. We provide these clean, rendered fats, at each of our farmers markets. We also advocate for the removal of all seed oils from the pantry, as they deliver unacceptable amounts of omega-6 fatty acids.

Read More Information!
 
Unique Methods
Our premium angus beef cattle feed on 100% living Florida grasses and legumes. This key fact makes us one of the only authentic grass-fed beef providers in the country! Virtually every other producer utilizes a mixture of hay, silage, and grain as most experience winter where there is no grass
For more information on compliance contact Steven at info@OkeechobeeFarms.com

Our Mission
We strive to empower others to assert primary control over their own health and wellbeing. In this effort, we continue our commitment to providing folks access to Clean, Locally Grown, 100% Grass Fed Beef & Lamb,Pastured Pork, Pastured Chicken, Duck and Turkey. All properties adhere to best organic practices of regenerative agriculture and grass and land management without the use of inputs of any kind. Our Website is designed to providing the information you need to enhance your knowledge of clean, healthy eating and living.
This introduction has been an overview of what we do and how we accomplish it. All of what you’ve read here is made possible because of the support from people like yourself, interacting with us at our Green markets between Fort Lauderdale and Melbourne. We greatly appreciate that support, as it makes it possible to share the pristine meat that so many of our customers have grown to love. We thank you for the continued support and encouragement, provided since we began our operation in 2010, and for having the courage to help us change things a bit. Now we wish to encourage you to Jump In, peruse our website, and do some shopping. You’ll be glad you did!
We hope to see you at one of the Green Markets this weekend!

Lamb Rib Chops

Lamb Rib Chops are cut from our 100% Grass Fed Lamb Racks and are sometimes called Lollipop Chops. They will be impressed when they see a French-Cut “Rack” of Lamb which feeds 2-3 adults. Each lollipop is cut individually and trimmed for attractive plating of your creation. 100% Grass Fed Lamb Lolipop Rib Chops are 100% Pastured to perfection.

Lamb Rack

Lamb Racks from our 100% Grass Fed Lambs are the un-cut form of Rib Chops which are sometimes called Lollipop Chops. They will be impressed when they see a French-Cut “Rack” of Lamb which feeds 2-3 adults. Each rack cut individually and trimmed to perfection. 100% Grass Fed Lamb Racks are the biggest seller of the Grass Fed Lamb we offer, 100% Pastured.

Okeechobee Farms

Welcome to Okeechobee Farms. We practice regenerative agriculture and are certified by the Savory Institute as such. All our meat species are pasture raised here in South Central Florida. Local cattle ranchers refer to 100% grassfed beef as unfed,  and of course all hormones, antibiotics, and chemicals are strictly forbidden on any of the properties.

DESCRIPTION

Lamb Shanks Our grass-fed Lamb shanks, often referred to as Osso Buco found in traditional Italian cuisine, is a cross-slice of the lower leg which includes the marrow bone with meat all around it. They are cut around 8” and are an excellent choice for slow cooking and making a rich sauce at the same time.

Add some short ribs, chopped celery, carrot and gremolata (gremolada is a chopped herb condiment typically made of lemon zest, garlic, and parsley)to the crock and you’re all set for a hearty meal packed with healthy Omega 3s. Email us and request our list of Osso Buco recipes if you like. We’ll look forward to hearing back from you after the family enjoys your creation which, by the way, is generally not something you’ll see on the menu at many restaurants.

Each package contains 2 pieces, avg. weight 1.75 pounds.
